policy: This register distinguishes an open SPECIFIED design from a preregistered FROZEN instrument: SPECIFIED means mutable design only, with no freeze, authorization, or evidential verdict. A completed positive verdict can support or qualify an observation-ledger rung only after its architecture version is anchored, a pinned independent audit qualifies that exact row, and the ledger-control lineage explicitly selects it. A controlling FAILED verdict blocks or demotes the bound emergent rung to owed until an eligible later instrument passes all three gates; a later design or unaudited run cannot overwrite it. The register is separate from the frozen-prediction ladder, which is reserved for physical predictions against external data. Negative and control outcomes are reported with the same prominence as positive ones. Fail closed on post-hoc analyses labeled as validation, parameters revised after data, silent reruns, omitted controls, and any run whose configuration is not reproducible from committed artifacts.

ledger_controls.supersession_policy: INS-01 remains controlling after its FAILED verdict. A later instrument may supersede it only when that instrument is REPLICATED, binds an anchored architecture version, cites an origin-anchored independent audit that promotes OL-A1, and is then explicitly selected here. Until all gates hold, OL-A1 remains owed.

rows.title: OL-A1 (1,3) signature replication instrument
rows.decision_rule: Pointer while SPECIFIED: the binding text is the Tier A decision rule in the specification, copied verbatim into this field at freeze time. Tier A summary: arms A1 = 16384/128/96, A2 = 65536/256/96, and C1 = 16384/128/6 with five declared replicates per arm; observables O1 threshold inertia, O2 robust inertia at relative tau 1e-3 with reference (1,2)/(1,2)/(2,1), O3 degeneracy ratio against the reference band 2e-5..4e-5, O4 cone margin and rung ratio (retained 0.5725, declared band 0.35..0.80), O5 structural diagnostics, and O6 split-half inertia concordance; verdict REPLICATED, FAILED, or INCONCLUSIVE per the frozen rule, and FAILED demotes the OL-A1 emergent rung with equal prominence. Eigenvalue caution: the archived (1,3) threshold verdict rides on one eigenvalue at relative magnitude about 3e-5 against a 1e-12 threshold; at a relative threshold of 1e-3 the robust inertia of the retained rungs is (1,2) with one degenerate direction, matching the independently measured (1,2) receipt, and a fresh seed can flip (1,3) to (2,2) with no change in physical content. Every public sentence about this instrument carries that caution.
rows.seeds_policy: One fresh seed drawn at freeze time and five declared replicate ids per arm. The held-out split is stride-structured per rung (strides 8/35/141), so train/held-out parity structure is recorded and stratified across replicates. N = 5 resolves seed fragility at the 1-in-5 level only, and the report states so. The runtime environment is single and recorded.
controls: C-SUPPORT: matched support-density control at 16384/128/6; a fired control reads as mean signature degradation plus halved cross edges.
C-ANCESTRY: ancestry-permutation null at zero extra runtime; the null destroys (1,3) on at least 4 of 5 replicates.
rows.limitations: The committed campaign retains the manifest, summary, and fifteen per-arm receipt files but no raw feature matrices or fit captures from which an independent implementation could reconstruct every observable. The simulator's validate-only mode rechecks the committed receipt fields and frozen decision rule using the producer implementation; it is not an independent observable recomputation. The pinned campaign commit is present in the sibling custody checkout and is reachable from the configured GitHub remote's main branch; remote reachability closes only the publication-custody check and does not supply the missing raw captures or an independent observable recomputation.

rows.title: OL-A1 factorial carrier-count and support-size follow-up
rows.decision_rule: Design-stage pointer only. A later freeze must report threshold stability, continuous spectral margins, carrier-count and absolute-support-size main effects, their interaction, quantitative ancestry-destruction and synthetic-sensitivity gates, sham equivalence, and cone-margin scaling separately through one fixed estimator before applying a predeclared overall REPLICATED, FAILED, or INCONCLUSIVE rule. No component pass may overwrite a failed control or endpoint, and no component failure may erase a separately reported component pass.
rows.seeds_policy: No seed has been drawn. Before a future freeze, a target-blind prospective precision and power calculation must determine the replicate count from declared minimum effects, interval widths, multiplicity, and attrition; no fixed count is presumed sufficient. Fresh seeds form paired blocks spanning every retained factorial cell and control, with cell execution order randomized within each block, no seed redraw or optional stopping, and one recorded runtime environment. Runtime-only pilots may measure cost but may not expose signature, margin, or control outcomes.
controls: Degree-preserving ancestry rewiring must preserve carrier count, degree sequence, support counts, and one-point record marginals while breaking lineage correlations.
Depth-stratified lineage shuffling must preserve the population at every declared depth while breaking cross-depth family identity.
A sham identifier relabeling must preserve the complete ancestry graph and leave the analysis invariant.

A synthetic ancestry-sensitive statistic of known sign must pass a predeclared quantitative recovery gate through the same estimator used for the main and ancestry-destroyed cells; it has no promotion authority.
rows.limitations: This is an open SPECIFIED design, not a preregistration or authorization to run. Candidate carrier counts, absolute support sizes, fixed observer count, replicate count, statistics, and quantitative gates remain mutable until a target-blind freeze. INS-01 remains the controlling completed verdict and OL-A1 remains owed; INS-02 cannot supersede it unless a later REPLICATED result passes the anchored-architecture, independent-audit, and explicit-control gates.
